column3: a. 棕榈的, 多棕榈的, 繁荣的, 从棕榈中提取的
column5: Historians still debate what ended the palmy days of the Venetian republic.
column6: 历史学家仍在争论威尼斯共和国鼎盛时期因何终结。

column5: The lecture will schematize the brain's memory systems into three broad levels.
column6: 这场讲座将把大脑记忆系统概括成三个大的层次。

column3: n. 无端的指责, 挑剔;v. 吹毛求疵
column5: A few delegates caviled about minor wording, but the treaty passed unchanged.
column6: 几位代表在措辞细节上吹毛求疵,但条约仍原样获得通过。

column3: n. 开玩笑；嘲弄, 揶揄

column6: 正式提问结束后,访谈变得轻松,满是善意的调侃。

column5: The rubric imposes a procrustean standard on very different kinds of student writing.
column6: 该评分标准对不同类型的学生写作强求一致,削足适履。

column3: n. 先觉者
column5: Conspiracy theories claim the illuminati secretly guide world events from the shadows.
column6: 阴谋论声称光照派在暗中操纵着世界大事。

column3: a. 使人神魂颠倒的, 使人入神的, 令人欣喜的
column5: The cellist gave an entrancing performance that silenced the entire auditorium.
column6: 大提琴家的演奏令人如痴如醉,全场为之屏息。

column3: n. 岩石学
column5: She studied petrology to understand how volcanic glass forms under rapid cooling.
column6: 她研究岩石学,以弄清火山玻璃如何在急速冷却中形成。

column3: n. 美食家, 讲究饮食的人
column5: As a true epicure, he drives two hours for properly aged cheese.
column6: 作为地道的美食家,他肯开两小时车去买陈化到位的奶酪。

column3: n. 偷懒者, 游手好闲的人, 懒鬼
column5: The foreman threatened to dismiss any sluggard caught sleeping behind the crates.
column6: 工头放话,再抓住谁在货箱后面睡觉偷懒就立刻解雇。

column3: a. 骨的, 骨质的, 多骨的;骨的, 骨性的
column5: The scan revealed osseous tissue inside the tumor, which puzzled the radiologist.
column6: 扫描发现肿瘤内部存在骨样组织,令放射科医生困惑。

column3: a. <正>厌腻的
column5: After the long banquet the guests sat sated and unwilling to move.
column6: 长宴过后,宾客们吃得心满意足,懒得挪动。

column3: vt. 均衡, 平衡, 使平衡;n. 衡重体, 秤锤, 平衡
column5: A sharp downturn can act as a counterpoise to excessive market optimism.
column6: 一次急剧下行足以抵消市场上过度的乐观情绪。

column3: n. 所愿望之物, 迫切需要之物
column5: Reliable public transport remains the chief desideratum of this fast growing city.
column6: 可靠的公共交通仍是这座快速发展城市的头号需求。

column3: a. 嬉戏的, 爱闹着玩的
column5: The frolicsome puppies chased each other across the wet garden lawn.
column6: 顽皮的小狗们在湿漉漉的草坪上相互追逐打闹。

column3: a. 不相称的, 不适应的
column5: The fine seemed incommensurate with the damage caused by the oil spill.
column6: 这笔罚款似乎与溢油事故造成的损害不相称。

column3: n. 渐弱演奏(部分);a. 渐弱的
column5: The symphony ends with a long diminuendo that fades into silence.
column6: 交响乐以一段长长的渐弱收束,缓缓归于寂静。

column3: vt. 使...神圣, 视为神圣;n. 圣徒
column5: Locals believe an early miracle hallowed this small mountain chapel.
column6: 当地人相信,早年的一次神迹使这座山中小教堂变得神圣。

column3: a. 似骡的, 执拗的, 顽固的
column5: Her mulish refusal to compromise delayed the project by several months.
column6: 她固执地拒绝妥协,使项目延误了数月。

column3: a. 谦恭的, 殷勤的, 顺从的
column5: The complaisant waiter anticipated every request before the guests could speak.
column6: 那位殷勤的侍者总在客人开口之前就料到需求。

column3: a. 特别美味的
column5: The kitchen filled with an ambrosial scent of roasted garlic and thyme.
column6: 厨房里弥漫着烤蒜与百里香的迷人香气。

column3: a. 无限制的, 慷慨的
column5: The project succeeded thanks to her unstinting support through three difficult years.
column6: 项目能成功,多亏她三年艰难岁月里毫无保留的支持。

column3: n. 易怒, 暴躁
column5: His testiness in meetings often masks a deep anxiety about deadlines.
column6: 他在会议上的急躁常常掩盖着对截止日期的深层焦虑。

column3: n. 诡辩
column5: The professor patiently dismantled each clever sophism the student offered in his defense.
column6: 教授逐条驳倒了学生为自辩抛出的那些巧妙诡辩。

column3: n. 粮草, 秣, 食物
column5: The farmer stored enough provender to feed the cattle through the winter.
column6: 农夫备足了草料,可供牛群吃过整个冬天。

column3: n. 推理, 推论
column5: The detective solved the locked room mystery through patient ratiocination, not luck.
column6: 侦探凭耐心的推理而非运气解开了密室之谜。

column3: n. 开花, 花期, 全盛期;开花期, 花候
column5: The desert briefly displays its florescence after the rare autumn rains.
column6: 罕见的秋雨过后,沙漠短暂地迎来百花盛放。

column3: n. 稀薄化, 稀薄;稀疏, 疏松
column5: At high altitude the rarefaction of the air makes every step laborious.
column6: 在高海拔地区,空气稀薄让人举步维艰。

column3: n. 涩, 酸, 尖刻;涩度
column5: The critic's acerbity alienated readers even when his judgments were sound.
column6: 这位评论家言辞尖刻,即使判断中肯也会疏远读者。

column3: n. 玩笑
column5: His lecture mixed dense theory with unexpected drollery that kept students awake.
column6: 他的讲座把艰深理论与出人意料的妙趣糅在一起,学生们听得入神。
